text: {"lessons":["My account value fell from 98,248 to 89,770.70 over these periods, so I should accept that stock investing can involve losses and keep my apartment timeline and risk tolerance in mind.","Doing nothing during these monthly fluctuations avoided impulsive trades, but I should still review whether my holdings and allocation fit my goals rather than assume holding is always right.","Five stocks alone may not provide enough diversification; I should assess concentration and keep a deliberate plan for future salary contributions instead of chasing short-term price moves."]}
